scope: Apple allocation-controller lifetime after its public MemoryResource wrapper dies; two actual native focused tests, not in-flight Model cancellation or full-model revalidation.
machine: Mac16,12 / Apple M4 / 16GiB / actual macOS27.0.1; arm64 deployment14.4

implementation.ownership: Initial wrapper ref1, each successful allocation (including zero bytes) owns1ref, deallocate frees original MLX allocation then releases that ref; destructor and move replacement release only wrapper ref.
implementation.imported: ImportedArrayStorage uses actual mx::array owner and its existing overridden deallocate; it never creates a second MLX allocation claim.
implementation.runtime: No Context wrapper/Runtime reference added; no reaper or additional thread.
implementation.abi: Public class layout and unique_ptr representation unchanged; destructor/move assignment release the MemoryState controller explicitly.
implementation.portable_stride_checks: std::cmp_equal/cmp_less/cmp_greater handle signed MLX stride values with an explicit negative-stride rejection; no stride truncation.

cases.name: BufferSurvivesWrapperDestructionAndMoveReplacement
covers: zero-byte allocation retains controller through Buffer.reset

cases.name: TypedArrayAndImportedLeaseRetainBackingWithoutWrapper
covers: lease remains after original array reset
final lease release returns payload live_bytes and unknown-owner counts to0

reused_closure: Actual matched Apple GDN+Dense+I32Cast native closure from mtp-qwen35-apple-k1-complete-input-2026-10-24; no new native operator claim.
dependency_proof: Actual GNU.d project headers compared to current Windows source SHA catalog; no drift before link.
limits: Borrowed MemoryResourceRef itself does not retain the controller and cannot be used to allocate after the owner and all allocations disappear.
No promise that an external native device/context may die while its GPU work remains in flight.
No whole SDK, all allocation entry-point or full-model cancellation claim from these two cases.
